description: At night the Castle of Sigüenza glows warm on its hill, the floodlit fortress — a Moorish foundation turned bishops' palace turned Parador — rising over the sleeping rooftops of the old town. Crenellated walls and towers stand out against the starry sky, a sight the night routes call beautiful from every street below. Beneath it lies the medieval town of baroque streets, the cathedral, and the house of El Doncel.
